Context: 7. Attachment for debt and maintenance

- (10) The amounts drawn under Paras. 8 and 9 above shall be treated in the accounts as paid to the Government servant concerned, and the Court's order shall be noted against the item as authority for the charge. The Court's receipt shall be filed safely.  
[ Rule 178, Postal FHB, Vol. I, Rule 2.4 (7) (h) (i) of R & P Rules and Rule 228, CTR.]
